title: Distinguishing among reasoning levels of GPT 5.5 Pro via a grammar lens benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2611.00555v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Does the level of test-time processing effort affect a language model's computational capability? A formal grammar-lens benchmark method, derived from the theory of computation, generates novel data at specified levels, each successively more computationally powerful than the levels below. Using this data, we tested GPT-5.5, and GPT-5.5-Pro-Medium, -High, and -XHigh, showing incrementally increased acceptance of test data: 16, 40, 43, and 52\%, respectively, illustrating the benchmark's ability to discern fine-grained differences among models' added test-time reasoning levels. Additionally, as test-time compute effort increases, model responses diverge from human responses to the same data. This increasing disagreement may turn out to be broadly characteristic of more capable language models, introducing the potential of a general capability-versus-alignment conflict.

translated_title: 通过语法视角基准区分GPT-5.5 Pro的推理级别
translated_abstract: 测试时处理努力的程度会影响语言模型的计算能力吗？一种源自计算理论的形式化“语法视角”基准方法，能够在指定的层级上生成新颖数据，每个层级都比其下方的层级具有更强的计算能力。利用这些数据，我们测试了GPT-5.5以及GPT-5.5-Pro-Medium、-High和-XHigh，结果显示模型对测试数据的接受率逐步提升：分别为16%、40%、43%和52%，这说明了该基准有能力辨别不同测试时推理级别下模型之间细粒度的差异。此外，随着测试时计算努力的增加，模型对相同数据的响应与人类的响应逐渐产生分歧。这种日益增加的分歧可能成为更强大语言模型的普遍特征，从而揭示了能力与对齐之间潜在的一般性冲突。
tldr: 本文提出一种源自计算理论的形式化语法视角基准，成功区分了GPT-5.5系列模型在不同测试时推理级别下的细粒度能力差异，并发现随着测试时计算努力增加，模型与人类的响应分歧逐渐增大，揭示了能力与对齐之间的潜在冲突。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a formal grammar-lens benchmark derived from the theory of computation that distinguishes fine-grained capability differences across GPT-5.5 models' test-time reasoning levels, and reveals that as test-time compute effort increases, model responses increasingly diverge from human responses, suggesting a potential capability-versus-alignment conflict.
